scripts.dev: npm run build -w @it-discovery/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @it-discovery/contracts" "npm run dev -w @it-discovery/api" "npm run dev -w @it-discovery/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @it-discovery/contracts && npm run build -w @it-discovery/api && npm run build -w @it-discovery/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @it-discovery/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @it-discovery/contracts && npm run test -w @it-discovery/api && npm run test -w @it-discovery/web
